newsitem.title: USA: China buys 24,000 tonnes US soyoil - U.S. exporters.
newsitem.headline: China buys 24,000 tonnes US soyoil - U.S. exporters.

text.p: China on Wednesday purchased 24,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil for shipment from the U.S. Gulf during the period February 15 to March 15, U.S. exporters said.
"This business really shouldn't surprise anyone because we're very near the right prices (to attract foreign interest)," one U.S. exporter said.
The price of the soyoil was unavailable, sources said.
The soyoil will be shipped on the the vessel Kimberly, exporters said.
The U.S. currently holds a small freight advantage over its South American competitors, one exporter said.
